executionContext.note: Selected fixture bodies execute with this package's EventSource and event classes, a canonical local-server location and a real self alias. Their upstream Window/Worker environments are recorded for provenance; no browser or worker exposure/lifecycle conformance is claimed.

documentTitleMetadata.note: These eight unchanged fixtures use document.title only to form test names. The driver supplies the verified fixture title as fixed naming metadata. No other document member, identity, DOM behavior or browser lifecycle is provided or tested.

executionContext.workerBody: dedicated-worker/eventsource-eventtarget.worker.js uses only the reserved testharness import and ordinary EventSource operations. importScripts is a verified script-loading primitive, not a WorkerGlobalScope implementation.
executionContext.cookies: Each fixture needs an independent CookieJar and ServerCookiePolicy through the existing WPT runtime helper for cookie-driven reconnect and credentials resource state.
